name: Vulcan Pro Pickleball Backpack
description: The Vulcan Pro Backpack is a tournament-ready pack for players who carry multiple paddles and a full change of gear. A fleece-lined paddle sleeve protects up to four paddles, a ventilated bottom shoe compartment keeps sweaty shoes separate from clean clothes, and an insulated side pocket holds a water bottle cold through long sessions. A rear fence hook lets you hang the bag courtside.

specifications.features: Ventilated shoe compartment, insulated bottle pocket, fence hook

care_instructions: Spot clean with mild soap and a damp cloth. Empty the shoe compartment after every session and leave it unzipped to air out. Do not machine wash.
